scope: Heavy-lift agricultural multirotor UAV ESC requirements from mission through verification/release.

definition_status.DEFINED: Requirement statement, gate, verification method, acceptance criteria and evidence/dependency references are present.
definition_status.NEEDS_REVIEW: Requirement record exists but its structure is incomplete.

value_status.OPEN: Product value/selection is unknown and shall remain null/TBD.
value_status.BOUNDED: A user-approved or evidence-backed bound exists, but final value/selection is not frozen.
value_status.FROZEN: Requirement value/decision is baseline-backed and traceable.
value_status.NA: No product numeric/selection value is required; requirement is procedural/verification.

anti_hallucination_policy.unknowns: OPEN/null/TBD remain open until user input, primary evidence, derived calculation from frozen parents, or physical measurement exists.
anti_hallucination_policy.competitor_data: Benchmark values may bound or inform trades but shall not be copied into product requirements without a documented product decision.
anti_hallucination_policy.legacy: Faz2/Faz3/A2/B1 are historical evidence and candidate inputs, not automatic design authority.
anti_hallucination_policy.simulation: Screening calculations, scripts and simulations are not physical validation.
anti_hallucination_policy.release_claims: No flight-qualified/production-qualified claim before corresponding gate closure.
